labs.title: Localize an Extension Build Failure
labs.simulationLabel: Deterministic learning fixture; not SAP Commerce runtime
labs.objective: Use build inputs and failure stage evidence to identify a missing extension dependency.
acceptanceCriteria: Separates repository, manifest, context, and runtime evidence
Does not add global libraries without justification
labs.referenceSolution: Repair the declared dependency at the extension/build input, rerun resolution, and run a context-load test.

labs.title: Design a Compliance Document Model
labs.simulationLabel: Design exercise; SAP runtime execution unavailable
labs.objective: Model an item type and relation with lifecycle and migration evidence.
labs.referenceSolution: Use a source-backed item type for document identity and a relation where historical documents must be independently queried; specify migration and initialization assumptions.

labs.title: Diagnose a Transaction Boundary Failure
labs.simulationLabel: Deterministic learning fixture; not SAP Commerce transaction engine
labs.objective: Distinguish local atomic rollback from external compensation.
acceptanceCriteria: Identifies state that must remain atomic
Does not put remote call blindly inside transaction
labs.referenceSolution: Rollback local order state together, record the failed external reservation, and reconcile using an idempotent operation.

labs.title: Design a Secure OCC Contract
labs.simulationLabel: Contract exercise; no live OCC runtime
labs.objective: Produce a versioned endpoint design with authorization and test evidence.
labs.referenceSolution: Expose a stable DTO through a facade-backed controller, authorize resource ownership server-side, normalize errors, and test unauthenticated, unauthorized, invalid, duplicate, and success paths.
